project.name: pf-integration
project.description: PingFederate integration glue: the FederationAttesterKeyResolver bridge (attestation trust via federation), the OGNL issuance-criteria hooks (ClientAttestationUtils, OIDFederationUtils.authorizeClientEntity), explicit registration, the PF-signed federation entity servlet + PfJwksSigningKeyProvider, and the oidf.war assembly. Depends on client-attestation + openid-federation + the PingFederate SDK.
